extDescription.message: Blocks ads and trackers with TITAN network rules, Smart DOM, Auto-Skip, Live Shield and local adaptive protection.

ruleBudgetHint.message: Live diagnostics show packaged and runtime rule buckets without inventing a browser-limit percentage.

autoSkipHint.message: Clicks only clear Skip Ad buttons

preflightHint.message: Preflight + TITAN + Shadow protection runs before and inside dynamic page layers.

liveShieldHint.message: SWIR protection data updates from GitHub without remote executable code.

feedIntegrityHint.message: Validates schema, size and anti-shrink rules before new protection data is accepted.

titanHint.message: Session Guard • Regex Brain • Adaptive Network Learner • Closed Shadow Shield

resetMemoryConfirm.message: Clear TITAN Adaptive Memory? Current filter lists and your custom domains will not be removed.

pauseSiteHint.message: Temporary pause is for fixing a broken site and resumes automatically.

heuristicRecoveryHint.message: Safe recovery pauses local heuristic layers first while core network rules stay enabled.

heuristicRecoveryActive.message: Heuristic layers paused; core network rules remain enabled

heuristicRecoveryUnsupported.message: Safe recovery is available on normal HTTP/HTTPS websites.

heuristicRecoveryEscalated.message: Full site pause is active; core network filtering is also bypassed for this site.

heuristicRecoveryAllowed.message: The permanent allowlist already bypasses protection for this site.

heuristicRecoveryGlobalOff.message: Enable global protection before using safe recovery.

recoveryHistoryHint.message: Breakage Guard history stays local and contains only bounded recovery events.

pauseUnsupported.message: Temporary pause is available on normal HTTP/HTTPS websites.

persistentAllowHint.message: This site is on your permanent allowlist. Re-enable protection to use temporary pause.

adaptiveHint.message: Everything is learned locally in this browser profile.
